title: Car Wax vs Sealant vs Ceramic Coating: Which Do You Need?
meta_description: Wax, ceramic sealant or ceramic coating? How each protects your paint, how long it lasts, the prep it needs and which suits your car, explained plainly.
excerpt: Wax, sealant and ceramic coating all protect your paint, but they differ in how long they last and how much preparation they need. Here's how each works and how to choose.

keywords: wax vs sealant vs ceramic coating

faq.q: Is a ceramic coating better than wax?
faq.a: It lasts much longer and makes washing easier for longer, but it needs the paint decontaminated and polished first and has to be applied in dry conditions. Wax is easier to put on yourself and gives a warm gloss, but needs topping up more often.

faq.q: What's the difference between a ceramic sealant and a ceramic coating?
faq.a: A ceramic sealant is a thinner layer that's quicker to apply; ours lasts about 6 months. A coating is a harder, longer-lasting layer that needs machine polishing first and more careful application.

faq.q: Does a ceramic coating stop scratches and stone chips?
faq.a: No. It makes the paint easier to keep clean, but it won't stop stone chips or scratches. Paint protection film is the product for chips.

faq.q: Do I need to polish my car before protecting it?
faq.a: Only if the paint is dull or swirled and that bothers you. Protection seals in whatever is underneath, so any polishing has to happen first. Before a ceramic coating, we always machine polish.

Wax, ceramic sealant or ceramic coating? All three put a protective layer on your paint so water beads off and dirt struggles to stick. The difference is how long it lasts and how much preparation it needs.

Wax is the easiest to apply yourself but wears off soonest. A ceramic sealant lasts longer and suits most daily drivers. A ceramic coating lasts longest, but the paint has to be polished first, because a coating seals in whatever is underneath.

Our new guide explains how each one works, what none of them can do, and how to choose the right one for your car.
